Hi Tom —

Thanks for the quick reply. Answers below and a couple of implementation notes: 

1) SCIM department as plain text: yes — Redwood's SCIM ingestion accepts department as string and stores it as user.org_unit (no numeric transform required). See the sample column "department -> orgUnit" in scim_attribute_map_v1.csv.

2) Audit log retention: our hosted plan retains token-level events for 12 months by default. For 13 months we can enable extended retention under the entitlements add-on — I will include Marissa on the thread to scope the billing/entitlements change.

Implementation notes: 
- For SAML, because your assertion uses email nameID we'll want to validate that the NameID format is emailAddress and include an audience restriction for the prod SP entity.
- Please confirm whether ACS (Assertion Consumer Service) at https://prod.redwood.ai/saml/acs matches the metadata we provided, otherwise update and resend the IdP metadata.
- Service-account keys: we can integrate with your KMS/HSM if you want Redwood to rotate keys on your behalf; otherwise we can accept signed JWTs from the SA with mutual TLS.

I'll join the 10:00am ET call to go through the SCIM CSV and the IP whitelist testing steps.

-Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Call was helpful, thanks. Follow-ups from our security/compliance review:

I've attached our firewall export and a short spreadsheet with our identity namespace. We'll need the final SCIM mapping file finalized before we hit prod.

Tom
